proof_spine: Represent betweenness and segment congruence as primitive relation sets on one point carrier
State the SST dimensionless neutral axioms as one reusable setting
Derive congruence reflexivity from pseudo-reflexivity and inner transitivity
Derive congruence symmetry from inner transitivity and the derived reflexivity theorem
Expose collinearity and midpoint as derived relations without claiming a selector
Layer decidable equality, two-dimensionality, and the Euclidean axiom as nested settings
Build the source-aligned Chapter 2-4 congruence, betweenness, triangle-congruence, and collinearity foundation
Extend through the Chapter 7 midpoint relation without assuming general existence
Add the Chapter 8-10 perpendicularity, side, reflection, and coplanarity interfaces
Use exact Chapter 11 angle congruence, four direct segment constructions, and three five-segment applications to prove Euclid I.5
Derive segment addition and inverse five-segment under decidable point equality
Align the four exact angle witnesses and apply inverse five-segment twice to derive the SAS third side
Fold the two premises and derived third side into Chapter 4 triangle congruence

blocks.accepted_litex:
setting TarskiNeutralDimensionlessSetting(Point nonempty_set, Bet power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point)), Cong power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point, Point)), lower_a, lower_b, lower_c Point):
    forall p1, p2 Point:
        (p1, p2, p2, p1) $in Cong
    forall p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6 Point:
        (p1, p2, p3, p4) $in Cong
        (p1, p2, p5, p6) $in Cong
        =>:
            (p3, p4, p5, p6) $in Cong
    forall p1, p2, p3 Point:
        (p1, p2, p3, p3) $in Cong
        =>:
            p1 = p2
    forall p1, p2, p3, p4 Point:
        exist x Point st {(p1, p2, x) $in Bet, (p2, x, p3, p4) $in Cong}
    forall p1, p2, p3, p4, p5, p6, p7, p8 Point:
        (p1, p3, p2, p4) $in Cong
        (p3, p5, p4, p6) $in Cong
        (p1, p7, p2, p8) $in Cong
        (p3, p7, p4, p8) $in Cong
        (p1, p3, p5) $in Bet
        (p2, p4, p6) $in Bet
        p1 != p3
        =>:
            (p5, p7, p6, p8) $in Cong
    forall p1, p2 Point:
        (p1, p2, p1) $in Bet
        =>:
            p1 = p2
    forall p1, p2, p3, p4, p5 Point:
        (p1, p4, p3) $in Bet
        (p2, p5, p3) $in Bet
        =>:
            exist x Point st {(p4, x, p2) $in Bet, (p5, x, p1) $in Bet}
    not (lower_a, lower_b, lower_c) $in Bet
    not (lower_b, lower_c, lower_a) $in Bet
    not (lower_c, lower_a, lower_b) $in Bet
blocks.reusable_lesson: Use indexed point binders for axiom schemas; a named setting can carry the complete flat SST neutral prefix without global axioms.

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm segment_congruence_left_commutative:
    ? forall [TarskiNeutralDimensionlessSetting], a, b, c, d Point:
        $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, b, a, c, d)
    (a, b, b, a) $in Cong
    (b, a, c, d) $in Cong
    by def $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, b, a, c, d)

thm segment_congruence_right_commutative:
    ? forall [TarskiNeutralDimensionlessSetting], a, b, c, d Point:
        $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, d, c)
    by thm segment_congruence_symmetric(Point, Bet, Cong, lower_a, lower_b, lower_c, a, b, c, d) => $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, c, d, a, b)
    by thm segment_congruence_left_commutative(Point, Bet, Cong, lower_a, lower_b, lower_c, c, d, a, b) => $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, d, c, a, b)
    by thm segment_congruence_symmetric(Point, Bet, Cong, lower_a, lower_b, lower_c, d, c, a, b) => $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, d, c)

thm segment_congruence_endpoint_commutative:
    ? forall [TarskiNeutralDimensionlessSetting], a, b, c, d Point:
        $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, b, a, d, c)
    by thm segment_congruence_left_commutative(Point, Bet, Cong, lower_a, lower_b, lower_c, a, b, c, d) => $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, b, a, c, d)
    by thm segment_congruence_right_commutative(Point, Bet, Cong, lower_a, lower_b, lower_c, b, a, c, d) => $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, b, a, d, c)
blocks.reusable_lesson: A primitive axiom instance may need to be named explicitly even when its consequence is the desired definition clause; theorem-level endpoint rewrites then compose cleanly.

blocks.accepted_litex:
prop inner_pasch_witness_exists(Point set, Bet power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point)), first_line_point, second_line_point, first_side_point, second_side_point Point):
    exist x Point st {(first_line_point, x, second_line_point) $in Bet, (first_side_point, x, second_side_point) $in Bet}

thm between_symmetric:
    ? forall [TarskiNeutralDimensionlessSetting], a, b, c Point:
        $is_between(Point, Bet, a, b, c)
        =>:
            $is_between(Point, Bet, c, b, a)
    by thm between_trivial(Point, Bet, Cong, lower_a, lower_b, lower_c, b, c) => $is_between(Point, Bet, b, c, c)
    (a, b, c) $in Bet
    (b, c, c) $in Bet
    obtain x from $inner_pasch_witness_exists(Point, Bet, b, b, c, a)
    b = x
    (c, b, a) $in Bet
    by def $is_between(Point, Bet, c, b, a)
blocks.reusable_lesson: For conditional existential axioms, make the implication conclude an atomic existential-result prop; this preserves the mathematics while giving Litex a selectable and eliminable proof source.

blocks.accepted_litex:
prop is_segment_le(Point set, Bet power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point)), Cong power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point, Point)), a, b, c, d Point):
    exist witness_point Point st {$is_between(Point, Bet, c, witness_point, d), $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, witness_point)}

prop is_segment_lt(Point set, Bet power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point)), Cong power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point, Point)), a, b, c, d Point):
    $is_segment_le(Point, Bet, Cong, a, b, c, d)
    not $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, d)

thm segment_le_has_witness:
    ? forall Point set, Bet power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point)), Cong power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point, Point)), a, b, c, d Point:
        $is_segment_le(Point, Bet, Cong, a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            exist witness_point Point st {$is_between(Point, Bet, c, witness_point, d), $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, witness_point)}
    obtain selected_point from $is_segment_le(Point, Bet, Cong, a, b, c, d)
    witness exist witness_point Point st {$is_between(Point, Bet, c, witness_point, d), $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, witness_point)} from selected_point

thm segment_lt_is_le_and_not_congruent:
    ? forall Point set, Bet power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point)), Cong power_set(cart(Point, Point, Point, Point)), a, b, c, d Point:
        $is_segment_lt(Point, Bet, Cong, a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            $is_segment_le(Point, Bet, Cong, a, b, c, d)
            not $are_segments_congruent(Point, Cong, a, b, c, d)
blocks.reusable_lesson: Witness-based segment order preserves the synthetic language and remains directly consumable without numerical lengths.

    ? forall [TarskiNeutralDimensionlessSetting], midpoint, endpoint_a, endpoint_b Point:
